source_texts.ds1-office-lease: Example North Office LLC (Landlord) leases Suite 400 at 100 Market Street to Example Tenant LLC (Tenant). Tenant shall pay Landlord base rent of USD 5,000 on the first day of each month. Either party may terminate for material default after thirty (30) days' written notice.
source_texts.ds1-office-amendment: This amendment replaces the base rent clause. Beginning 1 March 2027, Tenant shall pay Landlord base rent of USD 5,250 on the first day of each month.
